name: Bells & Log Drums
subtitle: Ikoro, Obrom, Adomba & more
shortDescription: 6 log drums and bells of West Africa to play: Ekwe, Ikoro, Obrom and Cigogo.
longDescription:
Bells & Log Drums: 6 log drums and bells of West Africa from 3 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Ekwe, Ikoro, Obrom, Cigogo, Adomba and Gankogui.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can strike log slit drums, forged iron bells, brass cup bells and double bells to the beat of each tradition, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
